reason: No ads, offline, and the camera stays off unless I turn it on, so I would let my child use the free version. But 24,990 so'm every month for an app is a lot when the free part already teaches letters and numbers. I would not pay for PRO in the first month.
objection: I don't know what PRO adds beyond the free core. Paying monthly for something my child might lose interest in after two weeks feels like wasted money, and I would rather put that toward an English tutor.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few weeks on the free version my child actually learned English letters and asked for more, and parents in my kindergarten group said PRO was worth it, I would buy the yearly plan.
